title: Spire and Wolf
author: Tamsin Dunmore
blurb: Zephyrine Thornbury, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
